_dependency_manifest: responsibility Exposes shared VS Code task entrypoints for AgentCanon validation commands.
upstream design ../documents/runtime/SHARED_RUNTIME_SURFACES.md shared runtime surface policy
upstream implementation ../tools/agent_tools shared AgentCanon tool root

tasks.label: AgentCanon: Docs Check
tasks.command: if [ -d "${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon" ]; then CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon"; else CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools"; fi; "${CANON_TOOLS_ROOT}/bin/agent-canon" docs check

tasks.label: AgentCanon: Dependency Headers
tasks.command: if [ -d "${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon" ]; then CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon"; else CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools"; fi; python3 "${CANON_TOOLS_ROOT}/agent_tools/check_dependency_headers.py" --changed && bash "${CANON_TOOLS_ROOT}/agent_tools/scan_dependency_headers.sh" --changed --fail-missing && bash "${CANON_TOOLS_ROOT}/agent_tools/check_dependency_header_format.sh" --changed --require-header

tasks.label: C++: Select Compile Database
tasks.command: if [ -d "${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon" ]; then CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon"; else CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools"; fi; python3 "${CANON_TOOLS_ROOT}/static_analysis/cpp/static_analysis.py" select-db --workspace-root "${workspaceFolder}" --build-dir "${input:cppBuildDirectory}"

tasks.label: C++: clangd Check
tasks.command: if [ -d "${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon" ]; then CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon"; else CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools"; fi; python3 "${CANON_TOOLS_ROOT}/static_analysis/cpp/static_analysis.py" clangd-check --workspace-root "${workspaceFolder}" --build-dir "${input:cppBuildDirectory}" --source "${file}"

tasks.label: C++: clang-tidy
tasks.command: if [ -d "${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon" ]; then CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools/agent-canon"; else CANON_TOOLS_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}/tools"; fi; python3 "${CANON_TOOLS_ROOT}/static_analysis/cpp/static_analysis.py" clang-tidy --workspace-root "${workspaceFolder}" --build-dir "${input:cppBuildDirectory}" --source "${file}"
